creative_brief.emotional_promise: A quiet crescent becomes a wide moth in one visible, cooperative sweep; the guide makes that first bloom feel magical and understandable.
creative_brief.format_rationale: The folded guide fits beside the palm-size closed toy, while the fully opened inner spread provides one continuous setup-to-bloom surface. Six panels are sufficient for the unusual two-hand service assembly, everyday motion, troubleshooting, care, and safety without inflating a simple desk toy into a booklet.
creative_brief.physical_format: Two-page duplex half-letter landscape tri-fold, 8.5 × 5.5 inches open and 2.83 × 5.5 inches folded.
teaching_arc: Meet and orient the exact three parts
Load both wings at the entry state
Cross the open stop with both roots raised
Align and lower both roots together
Recover from a lift or jam without force
Remove for service, store, care, and use cautiously
typography: Titles and action labels — embedded Bitstream Vera Sans Bold
Instructions and captions — embedded Bitstream Vera Sans
Owner notes and reversible-service cue — embedded Bitstream Vera Sans Oblique
creative_brief.visual_motif: Celestial navigation marks—small stars, orbit arcs, numbered state cards, and a sweeping bloom arrow—echo the exact star apertures and paired rotation.

findings: The first complete render left the unusual raised-root assembly materially ambiguous because ENTRY, raised cross-stop, service alignment, and captured states were prose-only; it also called a two-hand steady-and-sweep action one-handed, cropped the cover wing tips, put essential boxes too close to trim, and used internal CAD-evidence language in customer copy.
resolved_changes: Rebuilt the inside spread around four exact Made STEP-part state renders labeled ENTRY UP, CROSS UP, ALIGN UP, and DOWN; defined frame 3 as SERVICE POSITION and added explicit high, low, captured, troubleshooting, and reverse-removal cues.
Renamed the first-use action STEADY + SWEEP and now explicitly tells the owner to steady the crescent with one hand and sweep the left wing with the other.

Refit the cover to show the complete product visual with breathing room, moved essential bottom boxes to an 18-point safe margin, and replaced internal CAD workflow copy with a concise owner-facing caution.
Rerendered both final pages in color and grayscale, inspected all four images at the intended half-letter size, and repeated the first-time-owner reading pass.
